title: A paid pool re-run measures the grown held-out set, on the operator's approval
goal: Once the operator approves its spend, the question pool is rebuilt over the grown held-out file lookup_heldout.csv, read only (pool build --ask), and one paid pool run (benchmarks.py run pool over every default arm with --max-usd 40, its --dry-run estimate in this item's notes before the run) records the heldout kind's right-answer rate on rows the earlier pool runs never saw, in kb/_self/reports/benchmarks.csv and the report

run: import csv,sys;r=[x for x in csv.DictReader(open('kb/_self/reports/benchmarks.csv',encoding='utf-8')) if x['scenario']=='pool' and x['date']>'2026-10-14' and 'heldout' in x['case']];print(len(r));sys.exit(0 if r else 1)

import csv, io, subprocess, sys; old = subprocess.run(["git", "show", "35b5b7cb2:kb/public/_retrieval/bench_pool.csv"], capture_output=True, text=True, check=True).stdout; seen = {r["source"] for r in csv.DictReader(io.StringIO(old)) if r["kind"] == "heldout"}; now = [r["source"] for r in csv.DictReader(open("kb/public/_retrieval/bench_pool.csv", encoding="utf-8")) if r["kind"] == "heldout"]; print("pool held-out rows:", len(now), "seen before:", len([s for s in now if s in seen])); sys.exit(0 if len(now) >= 20 and not any(s in seen for s in now) else 1)

gates.question: Which rows does the paid pool run measure and which rows of bench_pool.csv change? Held-out kind only (6.03 USD estimate; the 20 held-out rows replaced, the other 140 rows kept as earlier runs measured them) or every kind (67.74 USD estimate, over the 40 USD cap, full rebuild)?

notes: Filed 2026-10-14 by the correctness + held-out planning session: the operator asked that a paid pool re-run wait for their later approval, so this stays a draft in no sprint. It blocks the held-out fitness test's model-side reading (EP-gzr4mmkm) only once ST-rgfoek35 lands. Never plan it without the operator's approval of the spend. Triage 2026-10-23: the operator approved the spend of this paid pool re-run; plan it next. Operator 2026-10-23: all default arms (haiku-5-5 low and default, haiku-4-5, sonnet-5-5 low and default, router, hook, the two web arms), --max-usd 40. Dry run 2026-10-23 on the 20-row held-out pool before the rebuild: python3 _tools/benchmarks.py run pool --kinds heldout --dry-run estimated 6.03 USD for 140 runs; the rebuilt pool's own dry-run estimate replaces it before the run. Worker 2026-10-23, rebuilt pool (pool build, nothing for --ask to ask: no eval row lacked its check; its 20 held-out rows are none an earlier pool held): python3 _tools/benchmarks.py run pool --kinds heldout --dry-run estimates 6.03 USD for 140 runs (haiku-5-5 low 0.12, default 0.14, haiku-4-5 0.57, sonnet-5-5 low 2.04, default 2.81, router 0.36, hook 0, web arms 0 rows); the same without --kinds estimates 67.74 USD for 1432 runs, over the 40 USD cap, so the run is held-out kind only.
